note: Mirror these under Steamworks > Installation > General Installation.

cloud.note: Steamworks > Application > Cloud. Enable Steam Cloud, then set these.

note2: The game writes a "connect" rich-presence key of the form "+haulmates_join CODE"; Steam passes it to the client as launch arguments when a friend clicks Join Game. Accepting an overlay invite instead launches it with "+connect_lobby <id>" and the room code is read off that lobby.
